title: When Being Wrong Is Right: Reverse-Capability Audio CAPTCHAs through Psychoacoustic Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.28823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) have recently been shown to bypass audio CAPTCHAs designed around limitations of automatic speech recognition. To address this threat, we introduce reverse-capability verification, a general CAPTCHA framework that reverses the conventional human-easy, machine-hard relationship with respect to the physical ground truth. It selects challenges in which stable human perceptual limitations cause the human-reference answer to differ from the physical ground truth, while machine analysis tends toward that truth. Because the verifier accepts the human-reference answer, advanced solver capabilities and resulting improved recovery of the physical ground truth may instead strengthen the human-machine separation.   We instantiate the framework through psychoacoustics and design two audio CAPTCHAs: HIPI, a classification task, and YINGCHEN, a counting task, together with their conjunctive composition. translated_title: 当错误即为正确：通过心理声学设计实现的逆向能力音频验证码
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）最近被证明能够绕过基于自动语音识别局限性而设计的音频验证码。为应对这一威胁，我们提出了逆向能力验证，这是一种通用的验证码框架，它颠倒了传统上相对于物理真值而言“人类容易、机器困难”的关系。该框架选择这样的挑战任务：稳定的人类感知局限性导致人类参考答案偏离物理真值，而机器分析则趋向于接近该真值。由于验证器接受的是人类参考答案，因此更强的求解能力以及由此带来的对物理真值的更好恢复，反而可能增强人机之间的区分度。我们通过心理声学将该框架具体化，设计了两个音频验证码：HIPI（一个分类任务）和 YINGCHEN（一个计数任务），以及两者的联合组合。
tldr: 该论文提出“逆向能力验证”这一通用验证码框架，利用心理声学设计音频验证码，使由人类感知局限决定的“错误”答案成为被接受的标准，从而让越强的AI模型反而越难通过验证，HIPI和YINGCHEN即是其两个实例。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces reverse-capability verification, a psychoacoustically designed audio CAPTCHA framework that accepts answers shaped by human perceptual limitations, so that stronger AI solvers paradoxically fail more, as instantiated by the HIPI classification and YINGCHEN counting CAPTCHAs.
